event.proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,536 parameters at 99.150000%, a +0.150000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 69 prior macro-attempts in this family and 605 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0171/micro-0012 at 1,540 parameters and 99.02%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0171/micro-0013 (FF-output pair 236/180 discarded at 98.98%). This is a parameterization-preserving compression of the depth-shared feed-forward output map: union flattened coordinates 224 and 152, values 0.0909895152 and 0.0916932821 (difference 7.038e-04), using a weighted mean and integer reconstruction. Hypothesis: residual-stream reconstruction contains near-duplicate scalars distinct from FF-input redundancy, preserving qualification at 1,535 parameters. It is more informative than the next FF-output union (difference 7.163e-04) because it is the minimum-distortion isolated test of the complementary FF map. Official acceptance and rollback are unchanged.
